## `neuro.int16Array.toReversed`

Instance method on `Int16Array.prototype`.

> Copies the array and returns the copy with the elements in reverse order.

## Signatures

```ts
toReversed(input: { int16Array: <receiver>; prompt?: string }): Promise<Int16Array>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Int16Array.prototype.toReversed` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
